strings.name: Jane Campion
strings.summary: Campion studied anthropology and painting before film. Sweetie, An Angel at My Table and The Piano examine women’s experience, desire and autonomy. The Piano made her the first woman director to win the feature Palme d’Or. She also created Top of the Lake and won the directing Oscar for The Power of the Dog, continuing an examination of gender, power and social conventions.

strings.influence.rationale: Through The Piano and other films she portrays women’s experience; as an internationally awarded director she has widened space for women filmmakers.
